title: Design System: Huevia Wave Tabbar review prototype

motion.purpose: One interruptible SVG wave fill, no idle loop.
motion.name: wave-fill

motion.purpose: CSS colour/opacity path; JS skips starting fill. Source-inspected only.
motion.name: reduced

components.description: Source-derived all-coloured resting specimen with album selected. Runtime selection/wave/replay remains in app.html; this snippet demonstrates geometry, focus and press states only.
components.css: .ds-wave{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));height:64px;padding:4px;border-radius:32px;background:#ffffffed;isolation:isolate;box-shadow:0 10px 28px -16px #554b404d;backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);font-family:'Segoe UI Variable','Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei UI','PingFang SC',sans-serif}.ds-wash{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1;left:4px;top:4px;height:56px;width:calc((100% - 8px)/4);border-radius:28px;background:#f9e9e5;transform:translateX(200%)}.ds-item{position:relative;border:0;background:none;display:flex;min-width:0;min-height:56px;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:4px 0;gap:3px;border-radius:28px;font-family:inherit;font-size:11px;line-height:13px;color:#706b63;font-weight:450;cursor:pointer}.ds-item[aria-current=page]{color:#8c4b43;font-weight:650}.ds-item svg{width:28px;height:28px;display:block;overflow:visible}.ds-item[aria-current=page] svg{filter:saturate(1.07)}.ds-item:active svg{transform:scale(.95)}.ds-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #326a82;outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:340px){.ds-item{font-size:10px}.ds-item svg{width:27px;height:27px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-item:active svg{transform:none}}
components.name: Wave navigation resting state

components.css: .ds-replay{min-height:44px;border:0;border-radius:22px;padding:0 17px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:#fff;font-family:'Segoe UI Variable','Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei UI','PingFang SC',sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#242320;cursor:pointer}.ds-replay svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-replay:active{background:#f7f7f4}.ds-replay:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #326a82;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Review replay button

donts: Don't add an idle wave loop or turn the selected ground into an icon-only badge.
Don't treat this review prototype or its browser evidence as user approval, native validation or a global design change.
Don't promote illustrative photo layouts, account text, transfer status, review furniture or the local system font stack into production design rules without a separate decision.

rules.body: Keep all four icon identities coloured after the animation; selection is indicated by the whole pale capsule and deeper, heavier name.
rules.name: The Coloured Rest Rule

rules.body: Preserve the same outer inset on all sides; the selected ground is not a separate icon badge.
rules.name: The Even Inset Rule

dos: Do keep all four names visible and include the full icon/name pair in the selected ground.
Do preserve equal insets, concentric radii and the coloured resting state.
Do keep selection interruptible, keyboard accessible and responsive to reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Four visible functional names in the established order: 预设 / 同步 / 相册 / 设置.
All icons coloured at rest; one whole icon-and-name pale selection.
A brief wave acknowledgment followed by a still resting state.
narrative.northStar: A compact white floating capsule with pastel functional icons.
narrative.overview: This records the built browser proposal in this folder, derived from `wave.css` and `wave.js`. The user-pinned Wave Tabbar and four supplied frames inform the component; existing warm photo homes supply illustrative context. It is ready for user review, with approval still pending. It grants no authority to change the root design system, Android, processing interfaces or release artifacts.
